speaker: Doctor
text: That seems like a significant change in your breathing. Can you tell me how many cigarettes or other tobacco products you smoke each day, and for how long?

speaker: Patient
text: I don't actually smoke at all; I've never used tobacco products in my life. My main issue has been that dry cough that keeps me up at night, which started about two months ago. I do suffer from seasonal allergies and sometimes get heartburn, but I haven't noticed any blood in my sputum or chest pain. However, my PET scan last quarter showed hypometabolism in the parietal lobe consistent with Alzheimer's disease. Use this confirmed scan for diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Cough due to Post-Nasal Drip (Allergic Rhinitis) and GERD, with incidental finding of Alzheimer's disease on previous PET scan.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
